accuracy_retention_guard.molecule_independent_rule: min(frozen budget, strict remaining chemical-accuracy margin)

claim_boundary: All three source checkpoints and the preliminary H6 1.5 A run were observed before protocol v1.1 was frozen.
Protocol v1.1 only strengthens accuracy retention and failure provenance; it does not change candidates, search ranking, resource metrics, or optimizer settings.
The exact energy is used only by the final chemical-accuracy retention gate, never by screening or ranking.
The cases are exploratory multisystem generalization evidence, not blind confirmatory validation.
A budget-truncated search reports best-found accepted candidates, not a true global optimum.
Paper Measurement Cost is unavailable and no implementation counter may replace it.
